prompt:
Product image of one set of rugged street clothes for a near-future city dweller, standing in an A-pose. Show the clothing only, as a hollow outfit floating in the air with nobody inside it: the collar of the T-shirt is an empty opening.

Pose, the most important thing in this image: a strict A-pose, like a 3D character model sheet. The two long jacket sleeves are straight tubes that point sideways and downward, each one 45 degrees away from the body, each running the whole length of the arm to the wrist and ending in a plain close cuff. A plain glove comes out of each cuff on the same straight line as its sleeve, open and flat with the fingers together, pointing along that line, at hip height. Between each sleeve and the torso there is an empty wedge of white background that starts right at the armpit; the whole underside of each sleeve from armpit to cuff shows against white. Legs straight, feet shoulder width apart, a clear gap between the legs all the way up.

{materials}
The six colours are easy to tell apart at a glance: blue jacket, pink T-shirt, yellow panels, grey trousers, tan belt and gloves, green boots. Every part of the outfit is one of these six colours.

{construction}

The look is heavy, layered streetwear: thick, oversized, hard-wearing clothes with big simple shapes, deep pockets and bold blocks of colour. Smooth clean surfaces like a painted sculpt: plain colour on every part, clean and new, smooth cloth with only large soft folds, chunky shapes, clean edges between parts. The outfit is these things and nothing else: the jacket, the T-shirt, the trousers, the belt, the two gloves and the two boots, every surface plain.

Camera: straight front view, camera level with the chest, long lens with almost no perspective. The outfit stands upright and symmetrical.

Soft even studio lighting with gentle shading that shows the forms, the whole outfit in frame from collar to boot soles and from glove to glove with margin on all sides, plain white background.
